verdict.rationale: Morph serves open-weight chat models through an OpenAI-compatible API, so structured-output enforcement is a fair question for it. However, no evidence item mentions JSON schema enforcement, response_format, grammar-constrained decoding, or structured outputs. OpenAI SDK compatibility alone does not show that schema-constrained responses are supported.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enforce structured outputs against a JSON schema (or grammar) so model responses parse reliably
